species.summary: The first species of the body engine: a biped night-light with a lantern tail. Frame version 1, on catalogue pin 11 (54 records, clan C20 with the brow tufts borrowed from C18).

viability.rule: random copies from the species pools at every open locus (the body and face anchors tight), and children of crosses between them (their blends on the step); each built by the body engine and checked by the cage checks of the workbench. `constructed` counts builds with no error, `passed` those with no failing check
